## 🚀 Quick Start Guides

<details open>
<summary><b>🤖 Deploying a Discord Bot (Node.js / Python)</b> &nbsp; <code>~2 mins</code></summary>
<br>

1. **Choose Bot Plan**: Order on [bracknodes.in/discord](https://bracknodes.in/discord) — starts at **₹29/mo** (Zero Sleep Mode)
2. **Access Dashboard**: Log into your Pterodactyl control panel from client email
3. **Choose Runtime**: Select **Node.js**, **Python**, **Java**, or **Go**
4. **Upload Code**: Upload your bot files or pull directly via Git repository
5. **Secure Bot Token**: Add `TOKEN` to **Startup Environment Variables** *(never hardcode into git)*
6. **One-Click Launch**: Click **Start** — your bot runs 24/7 with automatic crash recovery

</details>

<details>
<summary><b>🌐 Setting up WordPress on cPanel</b> &nbsp; <code>1-Click Install</code></summary>
<br>

1. **Client Portal**: Log into cPanel from your [BrackNodes Client Area](https://bracknodes.in/billing)
2. **Softaculous Installer**: Navigate to **Softaculous Apps Installer → WordPress**
3. **Site Details**: Select your domain, enter site name, and create admin login
4. **Auto-Install**: Click **Install** — Free Let's Encrypt SSL auto-provisions in minutes
5. **Ready**: Your high-speed WordPress site is live on Pure NVMe storage!

</details>

<details>
<summary><b>⚡ Running Node.js / Express Web Apps on cPanel</b> &nbsp; <code>Flagship Tier</code></summary>
<br>

```bash
# 1. SSH into your hosting account or open cPanel In-Browser Terminal
# 2. Go to cPanel → Setup Node.js App
# 3. Choose: Node version = 18.x / 20.x, Application Root = your-project/

npm install   # install packages inside terminal or File Manager Shell

# 4. Set your startup file (e.g. index.js or app.js)
# 5. Click "Run NPM Install" then click "Start Application"
```

> **Pro Tip**: Flagship plans include full Node.js runtime, Git automation, and SSH terminal access. → [Explore Flagship Hosting](https://bracknodes.in/flagship-webhost)

</details>

<details>
<summary><b>🗄️ Connecting MySQL Database from Node.js</b> &nbsp; <code>Production Ready</code></summary>
<br>

```js
// Compatible with all BrackNodes cPanel and Database hosting plans
const mysql = require('mysql2/promise');

const pool = mysql.createPool({
  host: 'localhost',
  user: 'cpanel_username',
  password: process.env.DB_PASSWORD, // configured securely via .env
  database: 'cpanel_dbname',
  waitForConnections: true,
  connectionLimit: 10,
  queueLimit: 0
});

async function query(sql, params) {
  const [rows] = await pool.execute(sql, params);
  return rows;
}

module.exports = { pool, query };
```

</details>

## 🛡️ Key Notes

> [!TIP]
> ### 💡 Free Website Migration (Zero Downtime)
> Already hosted on another provider? Open a ticket at [bracknodes.in/billing](https://bracknodes.in/billing). Our engineers will migrate your WordPress site, databases, and emails with **100% zero downtime**.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> ### ⚡ Flagship vs Budget Web Hosting
> Both tiers run on high-speed **Pure NVMe SSDs**. **Flagship** adds automated daily disaster snapshots, higher RAM/CPU allocations, full Node.js & Git deployment pipelines, and a priority 24/7 support queue.

> [!CAUTION]
> ### 🔒 Keep Production Secrets Out of Git
> Never commit `.env` configuration files, Discord bot tokens, database passwords, or cPanel API keys to public repositories. Always list them inside `.gitignore` and pass tokens via environment variables.

## ❓ FAQ

<details>
<summary><b>🤖 Will my Discord bot go to sleep on a paid plan?</b> &nbsp; <code>24/7 Zero-Sleep</code></summary>
<br>

**No sleep mode**: All BrackNodes bot hosting plans run 24/7 with dedicated CPU and RAM allocations. Your bot never idles or shuts down.

- **Auto-Crash Recovery**: If an uncaught exception or crash occurs, our Pterodactyl daemon watchdog automatically restarts your bot within seconds.
- **Multi-Language Runtime**: Supports Discord.js (Node.js 18/20), Python (discord.py), Java (JDA), and Go.

</details>

<details>
<summary><b>🔒 Do I get a free SSL certificate with web hosting?</b> &nbsp; <code>Auto-SSL Included</code></summary>
<br>

**Yes, 100% free forever**: Every web hosting plan includes auto-renewing Let's Encrypt SSL certificates for your primary domain and all subdomains.

- **Zero Manual Setup**: Free SSL is auto-provisioned within minutes of pointing your domain and renews automatically every 90 days.
- **cPanel Management**: View certificate status and force HTTPS redirection directly inside your cPanel dashboard.

</details>

<details>
<summary><b>⚡ Where are the BrackNodes hosting servers located?</b> &nbsp; <code>Low-Latency India</code></summary>
<br>

Our high-speed infrastructure is housed in Tier-3 enterprise data centers with direct peering to major Indian network exchanges (NIXI) and domestic ISPs (Jio, Airtel, Tata, ACT).

- **Ultra-low latency**: Enjoy **10ms – 30ms ultra-low ping** across India and neighboring South Asian regions.
- **High IOPS NVMe**: All storage arrays use Pure Solid State NVMe drives with zero spinning disks.

</details>

<details>
<summary><b>🛡️ Is DDoS protection included on all hosting plans?</b> &nbsp; <code>Automated Shield</code></summary>
<br>

**Yes, fully automated out-of-the-box**: Enterprise network-layer DDoS filtering is active across all web hosting, KVM VPS, and Discord bot plans.

- Malicious volumetric traffic is detected and mitigated in real-time at the edge router level before it can impact your services.
- Included with every tier at **zero extra charge**.

</details>

<details>
<summary><b>💳 What is your cancellation and refund policy?</b> &nbsp; <code>Fair &amp; Transparent</code></summary>
<br>

We aim to be 100% fair, transparent, and customer-first. Please review our official [Refund Policy](https://bracknodes.in/refund-policy) for complete service terms.

- If you ever run into a technical issue with your deployment, open a priority ticket at [bracknodes.in/billing](https://bracknodes.in/billing) and our support team will resolve it or process an eligible refund.

</details>
